# TPC-DS-OBT Q40

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT warehouse_w_state, item_i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(sold_date_d_date AS DATE) < CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE)) THEN sales_price - COALESCE(refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(sold_date_d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE)) THEN sales_price - COALESCE(refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((item_i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49 AND item_i_item_sk = item_sk AND warehouse_sk = warehouse_w_warehouse_sk AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk AND sold_date_d_date BETWEEN (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY')) AND (sale_id = sale_id AND item_sk = item_sk)) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY warehouse_w_state, item_i_item_id ORDER BY warehouse_w_state, item_i_item_id LIMIT 100
```
